notes: Cash-basis county, governmental only. Statement lines from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds column (p4). Beginning cash not printed (only beginning cash-basis fund balance 8,636,082), so beginning_cash is null; ending cash/investments from Exhibit C (p3). Fund-balance roll-forward: 8,636,082 + 5,491,088 - 9,983,952 + 2,317,308 - 2,317,308 = 4,143,218. Capital Outlay 4,467,165 is entirely the Capital Project Highway Allocation fund (p4). Balance sheet from the governmental funds Balance Sheet - Cash Basis Total column (totals equal Statement of Net Position p1). Detail: General, Road and Inheritance Tax budget schedules (pp5-8); nonmajor special revenue funds per fund column from Schedule 4 (pp10-12); nonmajor debt service funds per fund column from Schedule 5 (p13). The Capital Project Highway Allocation fund has no schedule (statement column only), so it has no detail lines. Schedule 2 (p9, groups) and Schedule 6 budget-and-actual one-line fund summaries (pp14-17) not recorded (less detailed). General Fund Taxes 3,225,773 split into Property Taxes 3,116,983 and Motor Vehicle Tax 108,790 using the Exhibit D General column (p4). Budget-schedule Federal/State figures differ slightly from Exhibit D (General Federal 187,053 vs 186,465; Road Federal+State 729,955 vs Intergovernmental 729,991); recorded as printed. Public Transit (under Public Assistance) categorized Mass Transit. Inheritance Tax 'Local' 89,701 is printed as Inheritance Tax on Exhibit D. Read pages 1-17 of 17
